_comment: Raw-color baseline for `npm run tokens:check` (see scripts/check-design-tokens.cjs).
Each entry in `entries` is a tolerated raw-color violation of the form
and represents an exception that the guardrail will allow. New violations not
in this list fail CI. Keep `entries` as small as possible; prefer adding
intentionally renders via raw `@mui/material` primitives — the wizard is
an isolated MUI island, not a DS surface. MUI's own theme handles color,
so today the wizard does not leak hex/rgba literals into the .tsx files
and `entries` remains empty. If a future change forces raw color literals
inside the wizard (e.g. a sx-prop hex), the path `frontend/src/routes/setup/...`
is the allowed scope to baseline here under this carve-out. The wizard's
